context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's formData option to upload files using multipart/form-data encoding with proper file stream handling.
capability_tested: Multipart Form Data with File Uploads

checklist.name: formData option usage
checklist.description: Uses the formData option to construct multipart requests

checklist.name: File streaming
checklist.description: Uses fs.createReadStream() to stream files as part of formData

checklist.name: Mixed content
checklist.description: Includes both file streams and regular text fields in the same formData object

checklist.name: Multiple files
checklist.description: Correctly handles multiple file uploads in a single request using formData

checklist.name: Custom options
checklist.description: Sets custom file options like filename or contentType using the formData field configuration
